popup-cro skill v1.1.0 adds comprehensive expertise and best practices for popup and modal conversion rate optimization.

- Expanded triggers, popup types, and audience targeting strategies detailed for versatility across use cases.
- In-depth best practices for design, timing, copywriting, and mobile experiences added to minimize annoyance and boost conversions.
- Clear output format and checklists for assessment, implementation, compliance, and analytics established.
- Contains specific benchmarks and measurement guidelines for effective popup performance tracking.
- Improved guidance for accessibility, privacy, and SEO-safe implementation.
